Game Overview

Cut Art Master is a adventure game built around quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Cut Art Master comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Cut Art Master?

Cut Art Master is a free adventure game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Cut Art Master free to play?

Yes, Cut Art Master is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
